newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $28 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $28 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Nov 18.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $28 billion of three- and six-month bills on Nov 18 to raise $1.525 billion as $26.475 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued Nov 21. The three-month bills mature on Feb 20 and the six-month bills mature on May 22.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127943Z5 and for the six-month bills is 9127944K7.
